lines.en: label utadorm40p1:
I knock on Uta’s door and make a silent promise to myself that I am going to be more normal today than I was during our fake date at the park.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Uta 的门，并在心里默默发誓：今天我要比在公园那场假约会的时候表现得更正常一点。

lines.en: But, in order to do that, I’m going to need her to answer the door as I can’t exactly be “normal” while standing in the middle of the hall and blankly staring at it.
lines.zh: 不过要做到这一点，我需要她来开门——我总不能站在走廊正中间呆呆地盯着门板，还能显得“正常”。

lines.en: Then again, I {i}could{/i} just go in.
lines.zh: 话又说回来，我{i}也可以{/i}直接进去。

lines.en: scene boundariesredux1alt
But that hasn’t exactly worked out well in the past.
lines.zh: 不过这在过去可没怎么顺当过。

lines.en: At least...not by any {i}standard{/i} definition of the word “well.”
lines.zh: 至少……按“顺当”这个词的{i}标准{/i}定义来看，谈不上。

lines.en: I did get to see boobs, though.
lines.zh: 不过我确实看到了胸。

lines.en: And getting to see Uta’s-
lines.zh: 而且能看到 Uta 的——

lines.en: scene utalolinude
scene iovisityuki1
And getting to see the almost fully grown version of Uta’s sure sounds like it would be nice.
lines.zh: 能看到几乎已经完全长成的版本的 Uta 的，听起来确实挺不错。

lines.en: I’m just going to go inside.
lines.zh: 我就直接进去了。

lines.en: scene black
scene utaiobath1
There’s no one here.
lines.zh: 这儿一个人都没有。

lines.en: I’m alone in Uta and Io’s room and there is no one here.
lines.zh: 我一个人待在 Uta 和 Io 的房间里，这儿一个人都没有。

lines.en: I can do anything I want.
lines.zh: 我想做什么就做什么。

lines.en: scene black
I can do anything I want.
lines.zh: 我想做什么就做什么。

lines.en: scene utaiobath2
: {i}Hah...{/i}I really needed this. Between all that extra course work and the time I’ve been putting into archery, my back and my head are friggin’ killing me.
lines.zh: : {i}哈……{/i}我真的太需要这个了。又要补课业，又要花时间在弓道上，我的背和脑袋都他妈快疼死了。

lines.en: : Having a best friend who works at a bath house is something everybody needs to put on their to-do list. This is the life, Io. This is the life.
lines.zh: : 有个在澡堂打工的闺蜜，是每个人都该写进人生清单里的事。这就是生活啊，Io。这就是生活。

lines.en: : It is certainly {i}a{/i} life, Uta. But this particular bath house girl is all booked up on friends, so “everyone else” is going to have to look elsewhere for their free bath benefits.
lines.zh: : 这确实是{i}一种{/i}生活，Uta。不过这位澡堂女孩的朋友名额已经满了，所以“其他人”得去别处找免费的泡澡福利了。

lines.en: : Or, you know, just bathe at home and leave people like me out of the equation altogether.
lines.zh: : 或者，你也可以干脆在家洗，把像我这样的人从方程式里彻底划掉。

lines.en: : Your anti-socialness is ruining my bath. If you’re going to talk, keep it to stuff like, “You’re the best, Uta!” Or, “You’re so pretty and your grades are going to get better soon and everyone will love you!”
lines.zh: : 你的反社交正在毁掉我的澡。你要开口的话，就说点“你最棒了，Uta！”或者“你真漂亮，成绩很快就会好起来的，大家都会爱你的！”之类的。

lines.en: : If grades had any impact on how much a person was liked, Nodoka would have more people to talk to than the fat girl and her lesbian companions.
lines.zh: : 要是成绩真能影响一个人有多受欢迎，那 Nodoka 能聊的人肯定比那个胖女孩和她的同性恋伙伴们多。

lines.en: scene utaiobath3
: That was mean. What has Futaba ever done to you?
lines.zh: : 这话太刻薄了。Futaba 什么时候惹过你了？

lines.en: : Nothing. And that did sound rude. I just forgot her name and wasn’t sure what else to call her.
lines.zh: : 没有。而且那听着确实很没礼貌。我只是忘了她叫什么，又不知道该叫她什么。

lines.en: : The nice one? The one who’s always reading? The library girl? The one who smells like lavender all the time? Even just “Nodoka’s friend” would have been fine.
lines.zh: 那个好脾气的？那个总在读书的？图书馆女孩？那个身上总有一股薰衣草味的？哪怕是“Nodoka 的朋友”也行啊。

lines.en: : Now you’re ruining {i}my{/i} bath. And you understood what I meant, so I don’t see what the big deal is.
lines.zh: : 现在轮到你毁{i}我的{/i}澡了。反正你听懂我的意思了，我不觉得这有什么大不了的。

lines.en: scene utaiobath4

: The “big deal” is that we’ve been in Sensei’s class for over two years now and you’re still the same Io you’ve always been. Would it really kill ya to just not be mean to people until they do something to you?
lines.zh: : “大不了”的地方在于，我们都在 Sensei 班上待了两年多了，可你还是那个老样子的 Io。在别人招惹你之前，你就先别对人家刻薄，真的会死吗？

lines.en: : Maybe. People have an easier time taking advantage of you once you start opening up to them. If I never do that, it greatly limits the opportunities people will have to ruin my life.
lines.zh: : 也许会。人一旦开始敞开心扉，别人就更容易占你便宜。如果我永远不那样，能毁掉我人生的机会就会大大减少。

lines.en: scene utaiobath5
: I’ve decided Miku is fine, though. She’s not as bad as I thought she’d be. Plus, I don’t think she’s smart enough to actually hurt anybody.
lines.zh: : 不过我认定 Miku 是没问题的。她没我想的那么糟。再说，我觉得她也没聪明到真能伤到谁。

lines.en: : Are you guys still hanging out? I kinda figured you’d have gotten fed up with her by now. She talks even more than I do.
lines.zh: : 你们还在一起玩吗？我还以为你早就受够她了。她话比我还多。

lines.en: : She does. But you two are a lot alike in a bunch of ways, so maybe I’m just...predisposed to dealing with that type of girl?
lines.zh: : 确实。不过你们俩在很多方面挺像的，所以也许我只是……天生就擅长应付那种类型的女孩？

lines.en: : And...what type is that exactly?
lines.zh: : 那……具体是什么类型？

lines.en: scene utaiobath6
: I don’t know. Loudmouth ex-tomboy looking to get in touch with her feminine side for reasons beyond Io-comprehension?
lines.zh: : 不知道。大嗓门的前假小子，出于 Io 无法理解的理由想要重新找回自己的女性一面？

lines.en: : That’s a really specific answer for apparently not knowing.
lines.zh: : 明明说不知道，这答案倒挺具体的。

lines.en: : Yeah, I guess it is.
lines.zh: : 是啊，大概是吧。

lines.en: : Also, I’m pretty sure Miku isn’t trying to abandon her tomboy side like I did. She’s just...also trying to do other stuff.
lines.zh: 而且我敢肯定 Miku 也不是想像我那样抛弃假小子的一面。她只是……也在试着做点别的事。

lines.en: : You haven’t abandoned it either. You’re the ace of the kyudo club and you have a pet beetle. Those aren’t exactly the most “girly” traits out there, Uta.
lines.zh: : 你也没抛弃啊。你是弓道社的王牌，还养了只独角仙。这些可算不上什么“女孩子气”的特质，Uta。

lines.en: scene utaiobath7
: I wouldn’t mind if you changed stuff like your wardrobe or the music you listen to, though. That would be the ideal setup for me.
lines.zh: : 不过如果你能换换衣柜或者听的音乐之类的，我倒是不介意。那对我来说就是最理想的搭配了。

lines.en: : There’s a problem with my wardrobe now?
lines.zh: : 我的衣柜现在有什么问题吗？

lines.en: : Too many bright colors. And like half of your bras have hearts on them. I don’t get it.
lines.zh: : 颜色太亮了。而且你有差不多一半的胸罩上都印着爱心。我不懂。

lines.en: : You don’t get it because you’re anti-cute and don’t even {i}wear{/i} a bra half the time.
lines.zh: : 你不懂是因为你反可爱，而且有一半时间干脆不{i}穿{/i}胸罩。

lines.en: scene utaiobath8

: Why {i}would{/i} I? It’s not like I’ve got anything to keep in check. The only reason I wear one with my uniform is because it’s uncomfortable if I don’t. But if I’m at work or home or something, what’s the point?
lines.zh: : 我为什么要穿？我又没什么需要兜住的。我配校服穿胸罩的唯一理由，是不穿{i}会{/i}不舒服。可如果我在上班或者在家什么的，穿它有什么意义？

lines.en: : What I fail to understand is why you need hearts or strawberries or other stuff like that on your underwear unless you’re showing it off to other people. Which-
lines.zh: : 我搞不懂的是，除非你要把内裤展示给别人看，否则为什么非得在上面印爱心、草莓什么的。而且——

lines.en: scene utaiobath9

: Wait. Nope. Gonna just catch myself right there and clarify that I wasn’t insinuating what it sounded like I was insinuating. That was, like...a generalization. Not a specifically-tailored Uta-based comment on-
lines.zh: : 等等。不，我这就打住，先说清楚我不是在暗示我听起来像在暗示的那个意思。那是，呃……泛泛而谈。不是专门针对 Uta 的量身评论——

lines.en: : I know what you meant. Besides, it’s not like I even have the liberty to show anyone {i}anything{/i} now that my phone’s locked.
lines.zh: : 我知道你什么意思。再说了，现在我手机都锁了，我连{i}任何东西{/i}都没自由展示给别人看了。

lines.en: : If I wanted to do that, it’d have to be in-person, and that’s...kind of...yeah.
lines.zh: : 如果我想那么做，就只能当面，而那……有点……嗯。

lines.en: : I just like feeling cute. That’s really what it comes down to.
lines.zh: : 我只是喜欢那种可爱的感觉。归根结底就是这样。

lines.en: : Uta...I’m sorry. You know I’m bad at thinking before I speak and I wasn’t trying to bring that up right-
lines.zh: : Uta……对不起。你知道我说话前不过脑子，我不是有意提起那件事的——

lines.en: : You know...it’s kind of good that you did, though.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗……你提了其实还挺好的。

lines.en: scene utaiobath10
: Uh...{i}why{/i} is it good that I did?
lines.zh: : 呃……{i}为什么{/i}提了反倒好？

lines.en: : Because if you didn’t, I’d have to.
lines.zh: : 因为如果你不提，我也得提。

lines.en: : I got another one the other day. From another different number.
lines.zh: : 前几天我又收到一张。又是另一个不同的号码。

lines.en: scene utaiobath11
: Seriously?...
lines.zh: : 真的假的？……

lines.en: : And I don’t even remember taking this one.
lines.zh: : 而且我根本不记得自己拍过这张。

lines.en: : How does this keep happening? Your phone’s supposed to block all picture messages, isn’t it? Can’t you complain to the carrier or something?
lines.zh: : 这事怎么老发生？你的手机不是应该屏蔽所有彩信吗？你就不能找运营商投诉什么的？

lines.en: scene utaiobath12
: And say what? Hello, Mr. Verizon- somebody keeps sending me nudes I took of myself when I was a kid. Can you make it stop, please?
lines.zh: : 然后说什么？您好，Verizon 先生——有人一直给我发我小时候自己拍的裸照。能请您让它停下来吗？

lines.en: : You don’t have to be that...direct about it.
lines.zh: : 你不用说得那么……直白吧。

lines.en: : It’s fine. I’ll just get another new phone. That normally stops it for a month or two.
lines.zh: : 没事。我就再换一部新手机。那样通常能管用一两个月。

lines.en: : What if you just, like...stop using a phone altogether?
lines.zh: : 那你要是干脆……别用手机了呢？

lines.en: : In 2020? How would I keep in touch with my parents? Carrier pigeon?
lines.zh: : 在 2020 年？那我怎么跟我爸妈联系？信鸽吗？

lines.en: : You could use {i}my{/i} phone to call them. And all of your friends live in the same building, so it’s not like you’d be missing out on contact with any of {i}them.{/i}
lines.zh: : 你可以用{i}我的{/i}手机打给他们啊。而且你所有的朋友都住在同一栋楼里，所以你也不会跟{i}她们{/i}断了联系。

lines.en: : Something tells me doing that would just end up with {i}you{/i} getting those pictures instead of me. And that’s not a thing I want for either one of us.
lines.zh: : 我有种预感，那么做最后只会变成{i}你{/i}收到那些照片而不是我。这可不是我希望我们俩任何一个人碰上的事。

lines.en: scene utaiobath13
: Ugh...how many is that this month?
lines.zh: : 呃……这个月这是第几张了？

lines.en: : Nine...I think.
lines.zh: : 九张……我想。

lines.en: : Five if we’re not counting duplicates.
lines.zh: : 如果不算重复的，是五张。

lines.en: : God fucking damn it. Maybe it really {i}is{/i} time for a new phone then. That’s way more frequent than normal.
lines.zh: : 操他妈的。那看来{i}真的{/i}该换手机了。这频率比平时高太多了。

lines.en: : It sure is...
lines.zh: : 确实是……

lines.en: : Whoever is doing this to you is fucking disgusting, Uta. I’m sorry you keep having to deal with it.
lines.zh: : 对你做这种事的人真他妈恶心，Uta。我很抱歉你一直要面对这些。

lines.en: : As long as nobody else finds out, it’s...it’s fine, I guess. It’s obviously not like I haven’t seen myself naked before, so...yeah.
lines.zh: : 只要没有别人发现，那就……那就还好吧，我猜。反正我 obviously 也不是没看过自己裸体的样子，所以……嗯。

lines.en: : Fucking...ugh. Literally nothing good ever comes from {i}anything{/i} sexual. It’s all just fucking gross and creepy.
lines.zh: : 操……呃。真的，{i}任何{/i}跟性有关的事都从来没带来过什么好东西。全都是他妈又恶心又变态。

lines.en: : I’m sorry for being gross and creepy, Io. I’ll try to do better in the future.
lines.zh: : 抱歉我又恶心又变态，Io。我以后会努力改的。

lines.en: scene utaiobath14
: That’s not what I-
lines.zh: : 我不是那个——

lines.en: : No, you’re right. All of this started because I couldn’t keep my stupid feelings in check, and now I have to deal with it for the rest of forever because I’m a disgusting pervert who bit off more than she could chew.
lines.zh: : 不，你说得对。这一切都是因为我管不住自己那愚蠢的感情才开始的，而现在我要永远背负着它过下去，因为我是个恶心的变态，咬下了远超自己能嚼的分量。

lines.en: : Uta...
lines.zh: : Uta……

lines.en: scene utaiobath15

: Even today, I’m {i}still{/i} like that. And I’d probably make the same stupid mistakes if I had never gotten burnt the first time around. That’s who I really am, Io. I’m gross. And I’m creepy. And I’m fucking {i}sad.{/i}
lines.zh: : 即便到今天，我{i}依然{/i}是那样。而且如果我当初没被烫过那一次，我大概还是会犯同样的蠢。那就是真正的我，Io。我恶心。我变态。而且我他妈很{i}悲哀{/i}。

lines.en: scene utaiobath16
: I am {i}so{/i} fucking sad, Io.
lines.zh: : 我真的他妈{i}太{/i}悲哀了，Io。

lines.en: : All I wanted was to feel cute and...pretty...and {i}wanted.{/i} But I was none of those things and just the fact that I {i}wanted{/i} them wound up ruining my brother’s life {i}and{/i} mine.
lines.zh: 我想要的不过是可爱的感觉……漂亮的感觉……还有{i}被需要{/i}的感觉。可我一样都不是，而光是{i}想要{/i}这些这件事，就把我哥的人生{i}和我的人生{/i}都给毁了。

lines.en: : No one’s going to ever want me. Like, {i}really{/i} want me. They’re going to find out what I’m all about and just pivot to thinking I’m a whore who chases after older dudes to feel validated.
lines.zh: : 永远不会有人真正想要我。我是说，{i}真正地{/i}想要我。他们会认清我是个什么东西，然后转头觉得我是个追着老男人跑、好让自己获得认同的婊子。

lines.en: scene utaiobath17

: Like, {i}look at me.{/i} I work at a maid cafe. I basically get paid to make people think about having sex with me. And the more they want it, the more I make. But that’s {i}all{/i} they really want.
lines.zh: : 就{i}看看我{/i}吧。我在女仆咖啡厅打工。我基本上是靠让别人想跟我上床来赚钱。他们越想要，我就赚得越多。可他们真正想要的就{i}只有{/i}这个。

lines.en: : The second it’s Uta and not Uta-{i}chan,{/i} it’ll all come crashing down because {i}Uta{/i} is a failure. She gave away her pride for temporary bliss, and now she’s got nothing left to give.
lines.zh: : 一旦变成 Uta 而不是 Uta{i}酱{/i}，一切就会轰然倒塌，因为{i}Uta{/i}是个失败者。她用尊严换了片刻的快感，现在她什么都没得给了。

lines.en: : I am so fucking sad.
lines.zh: : 我真的太他妈悲哀了。

lines.en: scene utaiobath18
: {i}I am so fucking sad.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我真的太他妈悲哀了。{/i}

lines.en: : I’d hug you if we weren’t naked right now...
lines.zh: : 如果我们现在不是光着身子，我真想抱抱你……

lines.en: scene utaiobath19
: {i}Hah...{/i}that felt good to get off my chest. It’s been a while since I’ve had my very own Io-style self-loathing session.
lines.zh: : {i}哈……{/i}把这些说出来真舒服。好久没开一场属于我自己的 Io 式自我厌恶大会了。

lines.en: : Well, it didn’t feel good for me. I hate hearing you talk about yourself like that. And I hate that my inability to properly word things is what ultimately led to that happening.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我听着可不舒服。我讨厌听你那么说自己。我也讨厌因为自己不会好好措辞，最终才害得事情变成这样。

lines.en: scene utaiobath20
: It was coming sooner or later, Io. It wasn’t your fault. Just have to...reset or something.
lines.zh: : 早晚都会来的，Io。不是你的错。只要……重置一下什么的就好了。

lines.en: : Listen, this...
lines.zh: : 听着，这件事……

lines.en: : I know I’ve said this a million times before and...I know you probably don’t believe me because, if you did, we wouldn’t keep coming back to it...but you’re wrong.
lines.zh: : 我知道我说过一百万遍了……我也知道你大概不信，因为如果你信，我们就不会一直绕回来了……可你错了。

lines.en: : You’re {i}so{/i} wrong.
lines.zh: : 你{i}大错特错{/i}。

lines.en: : Someone is going to love you for real one day because you’re amazing and strong and the fact that you’re able to put on a brave face after all that’s happened and {i}still happens{/i} to you is {i}insane.{/i}
lines.zh: : 总有一天会有人真心爱你，因为你很了不起、很坚强，而且在发生过那么多、{i}现在还在发生{/i}那么多事之后，你还能装出一副勇敢的样子，这简直{i}疯了{/i}。

lines.en: scene utaiobath21

: Sex is...it’s not as...I get that I look at it differently from most people. And I get that {i}I’m{/i} the one who’s weird for doing that, not you. You’re totally normal and not creepy or gross at all.
lines.zh: : 性……它没有那么……我知道我看待它的方式和大多数人不一样。{i}我{/i}也知道我才是那个怪人，不是你。你完全正常，一点都不变态也不恶心。

lines.en: scene utaiobath22
: And if someone as fucking backwards as {i}me{/i} can see that about you, someone else obviously will.
lines.zh: : 而且如果连{i}我{/i}这么他妈不开窍的人都能看出你这一点，别人显然也会。
: Io……

lines.en: scene utaiobath23
: In summation, I am very clearly not a person who has the right to tell {i}anyone{/i} to stop self-deprecating when that very trait is roughly 50%% of my personality.
lines.zh: : 总结一下吧——明明自我贬低大概占了性格的 50%，我却非常清楚地没有资格去叫{i}任何人{/i}别再自我贬低。

lines.en: : But Uta, if I ever hear you talk down on yourself to that extent again, I am going to slap you so hard that you’re going to forget that naked pictures of you were ever leaked in the first place.
lines.zh: : 可是 Uta，如果再让我听到你把自己贬到那种程度，我会一巴掌把你扇到连自己的裸照曾经被泄露过这码事都忘掉。

lines.en: : Well, damn. If you have that power, just hit me now.
lines.zh: : 哇哦。你要有那本事，现在就打我吧。

lines.en: scene utaiobath24
: If I really did have that power, you know I would.
lines.zh: : 我如果真有那本事，你知道我会的。

lines.en: : You’re the only person I’d do anything for, Uta. I mean that.
lines.zh: : 你是唯一一个我愿意为她做任何事的人，Uta。我是认真的。

lines.en: : Maybe a couple years ago, sure. But you’ve got Sensei now. It’s not {i}just me{/i} anymore.
lines.zh: : 几年前也许是吧。可你现在有 Sensei 了。不再{i}只有我{/i}了。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t do anything for Sensei. If I would, there’d be no need for a throuple in the first place since I could just take one for the team and let him violate me.
lines.zh: : 我可不会为 Sensei 做任何事。如果会的话，那根本就用不着什么三人行了——我直接为团队牺牲一下，让他糟蹋我就完了。

lines.en: : This conversation’s about to get weird, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 这对话马上要变得奇怪了，是吧？

lines.en: scene utaiobath25

: I’m telling you- it really {i}is{/i} the best option for everyone. Plus, you probably wouldn’t think of yourself as such a pervert anymore if you were standing next to Sensei all the time as his powers far surpass yours.
lines.zh: : 我跟你说——这{i}真的{/i}是对所有人最好的选项。而且如果你一直站在 Sensei 旁边，你大概就不会再觉得自己是个变态了，因为他的能力远远在你之上。

lines.en: scene utaiobath26
: Calling them “powers” is all sorts of wrong when they are actively making my life a living hell.
lines.zh: : 当它们正在把我的生活变成人间地狱的时候，把它们叫作“能力”可真是哪哪都不对。

lines.en: : He could love the real you too, Uta. I know he could. Like, he puts up with {i}me{/i} and I’m infinitely worse than you are.
lines.zh: : 他也能爱上真实的你，Uta。我知道他能。你看，他连{i}我{/i}都能忍，而我比你要糟糕无数倍。

lines.en: : Maybe that’s what you’re missing? Or just...not understanding, I guess.
lines.zh: : 也许这就是你漏掉的一点？或者只是……没搞明白，我猜。

lines.en: : You’ve got that right, Io...
lines.zh: : 你说得对，Io……

lines.en: : No, listen. It’s like...I know he could love you because it’s the broken people like us who work the best together.
lines.zh: : 不，你听我说。就好像……我知道他能爱上你，因为像我们这样破碎的人凑在一起才最合拍。

lines.en: : When you’ve got nothing left to give, natural instinct is to {i}take,{/i} right? And who better to take from than someone who doesn’t realize how much they actually have?
lines.zh: : 当你什么都没得给的时候，本能就会去{i}索取{/i}，对吧？那向谁索取，还能比向一个根本没意识到自己拥有多少的人索取更好呢？

lines.en: scene utaiobath27

: Both of you are like that. You think you’re all washed up and unworthy of anyone’s feelings, so you flail and you fumble until you’re so desperate for companionship that you’re talking to people like {i}me.{/i}
lines.zh: : 你们俩都是那样。你觉得自己已经完蛋了，配不上任何人的感情，于是你挣扎、你笨手笨脚，直到孤渴望陪伴到了极点，居然开始跟{i}我{/i}这种人说话。

lines.en: : That’s probably why I fell for him in the first place. Like {i}really{/i} fell for him. Because I saw pieces of you in there and they made me feel at home.
lines.zh: : 大概这就是为什么我当初会喜欢上他。{i}是真的{/i}喜欢上他。因为我在他身上看到了你的碎片，而那些碎片让我有家的感觉。

lines.en: : At the end of the day, I can want and wish and hope for his approval until I’m old and gray...
lines.zh: : 说到底，我可以一直渴望、祈愿、盼着得到他的认可，直到我老得头发花白……

lines.en: : But I think {i}you two{/i} would be a far better match than he and I ever would.
lines.zh: : 但我认为{i}你们俩{/i}会远比他和我更般配。

lines.en: scene utaiobath28
: Just because...we’re perverted? And broken and sad and stuff?
lines.zh: : 就因为……我们变态？还破碎、还悲哀什么的？

lines.en: : Because I think you complement each other well. And that you can fill each other’s voids in a way that nobody else I’ve come across really can.
lines.zh: : 因为我觉得你们互补得很好。你们能以我见过的任何人都做不到的方式，填补彼此的空洞。

lines.en: : Though, I also won’t deny that part of it might be because I can’t imagine anyone ever complementing {i}me{/i} to that extent. I’m probably just better off alone, all things considered.
lines.zh: : 不过我也不否认，其中一部分原因大概是我想象不出有谁能那样地跟{i}我{/i}互补。综合考虑下来，我大概还是一个人待着比较好。

lines.en: : To be honest, if you actually {i}did{/i} have feelings for Sensei, my biggest fear would probably become the two of you leaving me since I know I’d have no purpose anymore.
lines.zh: : 说实话，如果你{i}真的{/i}对 Sensei 有感情，我最大的恐惧大概会变成你们俩丢下我，因为我知道那样我就没有存在的意义了。

lines.en: : How could I leave you alone at this point in our lives? I need you just as much as you need me.
lines.zh: : 在我们人生的这个阶段，我怎么能丢下你一个人？我需要你，不亚于你需要我。

lines.en: : But wouldn’t having someone else ease that burden a little? It’d be like walking with two crutches instead of just one. We could all lean on {i}each other.{/i}
lines.zh: : 可多一个人来分担这份重担不是更好吗？就像拄两根拐杖走路而不是一根。我们可以{i}互相{/i}倚靠。

lines.en: : Also, if you {i}really{/i} spend as much time thinking about all of that “physical” stuff as you say you do, you might actually be able to sate his {i}appetite.{/i}
lines.zh: : 还有，如果你{i}真的{/i}像自己说的那样，花那么多时间琢磨那些“肉体”上的事，你大概真能填饱他的{i}胃口{/i}。

lines.en: scene utaiobath29
: That’s just my opinion, though.
lines.zh: : 不过这只是我的个人看法。

lines.en: : You...
: You’ve really thought this through, huh?...
lines.zh: : 你真的把这事想得很透，是吧？……

lines.en: : It’s less “thinking it through” and more just a vibe. But the best outcome is never what either one of us ends up with, so this will probably always just be a pipe dream of mine.
lines.zh: : 与其说是“想得很透”，不如说是一种感觉。可最好的结局从来都落不到我们任何一个人头上，所以这大概永远只是我的白日梦。

lines.en: : If your feelings ever change, though...and you {i}do{/i} start to see Sensei in the same light that I do...
lines.zh: : 不过如果你的感情哪天变了……你{i}真的{/i}开始用和我一样的眼光看 Sensei 的话……

lines.en: scene black
: Don’t let me be the barrier between you.
lines.zh: : 别让我成为你们之间的障碍。

lines.en: : Because I know you.
lines.zh: : 因为我了解你。

lines.en: : And I know you would.
lines.zh: : 而且我知道你会。
